roadmap_step: P08 step 5.3: static Dirichlet-phi combined full-grid MMS

deferred.neumann_phi_reason: User decision (1 October 2026): the Neumann-phi variants are deferred until after this step.
deferred.transverse_wave_controls: Low-degree / transverse-wave controls belong to the step-6 transverse-wave check, not to this step.

note: Static Dirichlet-phi combined MMS on the full grids. Two arms per frozen P06N variant: 'prescribed' feeds perpendicular_rhs the exact owner-averaged phi (frozen P06N owner values); 'solved' solves the P07 Dirichlet problem for psi = phi + tau Ti with the owner-averaged exact positive operator O(psi) as right-hand side and psi's exact wall trace (value + tangential gradient) as boundary data, then feeds phi_h = psi_h - tau Ti to perpendicular_rhs. omega is the catalogue's own independent field: the arms test the phi-solve-in-the-RHS pipeline; omega-phi consistency is a P09 time-evolution concern. References are re-frozen for the final operator (autodiff / q2 / fixed_radius): bracket = P05N raw_R, curvature = P06N evolution-weighted raw_R, diffusion = P07N O_q3 exact face flux, plus O(psi) and the autodiff-divergence midpoint reference of psi. There is no acceptance gate in the campaign: solver gates (consistency, convergence) and finiteness are recorded as pass/fail, the headline order criterion is informational, and the user decides acceptance. The phi solve uses rtol 1e-11 (the MEASUREMENT setting): the production default 1e-8 (PHI_RTOL_DEFAULT) leaves a linear-solve error of about 2e-8 relative on the real exports, which exceeds the phi-solve discretization error at N48/N64 (7e-9 / 2.4e-9 for the smoothest field) and would corrupt the measured orders. The linear-solve error of every variant is reported through the discrete-consistency gate (a) (threshold 1e-8 relative, M-weighted).
